meta.name: Doctor Who Classic: Classic Doctor Who
meta.description:
The Doctor has landed on Pluto! Travel back through time and space with all seven original incarnations of The Doctor as he faces Daleks, Cybermen, The Master, and more — all day, every day.

Shows: Classic Doctor Who, Classic Doctor Who: The Dalek Invasion of Earth, Classic Doctor Who: The Talons of Weng-Chiang, Classic Doctor Who: The Daleks, Classic Doctor Who: The Seeds of Doom
Available on: Pluto TV, Tubi, Plex
